## About
All Makes Collision is a body shop at 1000 River Rd in San Marcos. We handle collision repair, auto painting and detailing for all types of vehicles, whether you drive a compact car, a luxury sedan or a rugged SUV.
Our promise is simple: we will never compromise the quality and safety of repairs to your vehicle. Chris Avalos owns the shop, and you'll also meet Derwin Castillo, Eddie Serrano, Gabriel Avalos, Adrian Avalos and Debbie Avalos when you come by.
Our neighbors have rated us 4.7 on Google across 202 reviews. We're open weekdays and closed on weekends.

## Services
- Collision repair: Collision repair for all types of vehicles, bringing yours back to its pre-accident condition.
- Auto painting: Auto body painting and scratch removal for a finish that matches your car's original look.
- Detailing: From removing scratches to polishing every inch, we clean up your car inside and out.

## FAQ
Q: Where do I get a claim number?
A: Your insurance company gives you a claim number when you report your accident. Jot it down and bring it with you when you come in to start the repair, and we will do the rest.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No, we are closed on Saturdays and Sundays.

Q: Will the parts be ordered before I drop off my car?
A: Yes. We generally order your parts when we write the estimate and schedule your drop-off a couple of days later. If your vehicle isn't safe to drive, we'll help you arrange a rental as soon as possible.
